definitions.gloss: approval; adoption; passage (of a bill, motion)
definitions.explanation: Official approval or adoption of a proposal, bill, or motion by a voting body such as a parliament or committee.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}が{賛成多数|さんせいたすう}で{可決|かけつ}された。
examples.english: The bill was passed with a majority vote.

examples.japanese: {予算案|よさんあん}の{可決|かけつ}は{来週|らいしゅう}になる{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The budget proposal is expected to be approved next week.

examples.japanese: {動議|どうぎ}は{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}で{可決|かけつ}された。

notes:
USAGE: Used in political and formal organizational contexts when a proposal or bill is officially approved.

PATTERNS:
・{可決|かけつ}する (to pass, to approve)
・{可決|かけつ}される (to be passed/approved)
・{賛成多数|さんせいたすう}で{可決|かけつ} (passed with majority support)
・{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}で{可決|かけつ} (passed unanimously)

TYPES OF PASSAGE:
・{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}{可決|かけつ} (passed by House of Representatives)
・{参議院|さんぎいん}{可決|かけつ} (passed by House of Councillors)
・{委員会|いいんかい}{可決|かけつ} (passed by committee)

ANTONYM:
・{否決|ひけつ} (rejection, voting down)
